rows.traditional: 兩個 + N + 都唔 + P
rows.jyutping: loeng5 go3 N dou1 m4 P
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern when exactly two N are meant, as in 兩個定義都唔啱.

example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 go3 daap3 on3 dou1 m4 ngaam1

rows.traditional: A 同 B 都唔 V
rows.jyutping: A tung4 B dou1 m4 V
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese pattern for saying that neither A nor B does or has the stated predicate.

example.english: Neither my older brother nor I eat spicy food.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 go1 dou1 m4 sik6 laat6 je5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that neither of two people or things has, is, or does PRED.

example.english: Neither of them likes this movie.
example.traditional: 兩個人都唔鍾意呢套戲。
example.jyutping: loeng5 go3 jan4 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 ni1 tou3 hei3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that someone is similarly not doing or being something.

example.english: Ming isn't going, and neither am I.
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 m4 heoi3 ngo5 dou1 m4 heoi3
